# [mods] Roof racks, sliders and storage

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Mount crossbars or drop-in bars onto factory rails using specific brackets with adhesive foam. [t191]

## Parts

- 2-inch Tent Risers: Required to prevent arms from getting trapped when using a rooftop tent with the rack installed. [t191]
- Uptop Overland Rack: Features a flat rectangular platform with door cutouts and rivnut mounting points. [t191]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use adhesive watertight foam on all mounting feet, especially where brackets are flat against curved roof sections. [t191]
- Read installation instructions before the rack arrives and gather optional tools beforehand for a single-day install. [t191]
- Consider dual 10-inch light bars instead of one long bar to manage electrical load if running high-amp accessories. [t191]

## Common mistakes

- Ordering a generic 40-inch fairing cutout without verifying the specific rack model first, leading to extra costs. [t191]
- Installing front support feet that only use one rivnut per side on a curved roof, causing paint buckling and bottoming out. [t191]
